title: Rex's Rubber Ducky Dilemma
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, cute expressive characters with big eyes, exaggerated funny facial expressions, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16

priya.look: Young woman, early 20s. Fair skin, long soft wavy dark-brown hair, small nose pin, elegant pastel yellow kurta with white embroidery, white leggings, small earrings. Bright, expressive face.

rex.look: Large German Shepherd, fawn and black fur, floppy ears, blue collar. Majestic posture, but can look goofy or terrified.

scenes.image: [[priya]] looks confused, holding a tiny, bright yellow rubber ducky. [[rex]] is far behind her, peeking from behind a sofa, eyes wide with terror.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Mera brave dog, Rex, ka ek secret hai.
scenes.say: मेरा ब्रेव डॉग, रेक्स, का एक सीक्रेट है।

scenes.image: Close up on [[rex]] looking majestic and alert, standing guard at the door.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Yeh hai Rex. Mera sabse loyal companion.
scenes.say: ये है रेक्स। मेरा सबसे लॉयल कंपेनियन।

scenes.image: [[priya]] affectionately petting [[rex]]'s head. Rex looks happy and strong.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Uska size dekho. Kitna strong lagta hai na?
scenes.say: उसका साइज़ देखो। कितना स्ट्रॉन्ग लगता है ना?

scenes.image: [[rex]] barking fiercely at a delivery person at the gate (person's back visible).
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rex, humesha ghar ka protector tha.
scenes.say: रेक्स, हमेशा घर का प्रोटेक्टर था।

scenes.image: [[rex]] chasing a squirrel up a tree, barking playfully.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Squirrels ko bhagana, uski favourite hobby thi.
scenes.say: स्क्विरल्स को भगाना, उसकी फेवरेट हॉबी थी।

scenes.image: [[rex]] proudly sitting with a chewed-up tennis ball at [[priya]]'s feet.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Ball laane mein woh champion tha.
scenes.say: बॉल लाने में वो चैंपियन था।

scenes.image: [[priya]] laughing, hugging [[rex]] tight. Rex looks happy.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Mujhe lagta tha woh kisi se nahi darta.
scenes.say: मुझे लगता था वो किसी से नहीं डरता।

scenes.image: [[priya]] is cleaning her living room, finds a small, bright yellow rubber ducky under the sofa.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Ek din, maine sofa ke neeche...
scenes.say: एक दिन, मैंने सोफ़ा के नीचे...

scenes.image: Close-up on the small, yellow rubber ducky. It has a slightly goofy, smiling face.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Yeh chhota sa yellow rubber ducky!
scenes.say: ये छोटा सा येलो रबर डकी!

scenes.image: [[priya]] picks up the ducky, smiles. [[rex]] is entering the room, looking happy.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Aww, kitna cute hai yeh little ducky!
scenes.say: ऑव, कितना क्यूट है ये लिटिल डकी!

scenes.image: [[priya]] casually places the ducky on the coffee table. [[rex]] walks closer, his tail wagging.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Maine ise coffee table par rakh diya.
scenes.say: मैंने इसे कॉफी टेबल पर रख दिया।

scenes.image: [[rex]] sees the ducky. His tail stops wagging, ears perk up, eyes widen in shock.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aur phir... jo hua, woh unbelievable tha.
scenes.say: और फिर... जो हुआ, वो अनबिलीवेबल था।

scenes.image: [[rex]] lets out a high-pitched yelp, backing away quickly, bumping into a chair.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Ahhh! Yeh kya hai! Bhagao isko!
scenes.say: आह! ये क्या है! भगाओ इसको!

scenes.image: [[priya]] looks totally confused, looking from the ducky to [[rex]].
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Rex? Kya hua? Kyun bhaag raha hai?
scenes.say: रेक्स? क्या हुआ? क्यों भाग रहा है?

scenes.image: [[rex]] is now hiding completely behind the sofa, only his scared eyes are visible.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Woh... woh yellow cheez! Bohat dangerous hai!
scenes.say: वो... वो येलो चीज़! बहुत डेंजरस है!

scenes.image: [[priya]] picks up the ducky and tries to show it to [[rex]], who is still hiding.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Pagal ho gaya hai kya? Yeh toh bas khilona hai!
scenes.say: पागल हो गया है क्या? ये तो बस खिलौना है!

scenes.image: Close up on [[rex]]'s face, looking utterly terrified, shaking his head 'no'.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: No! No! Uske paas evil eyes hain!
scenes.say: नो! नो! उसके पास ईविल आईज हैं!

scenes.image: [[priya]] tries to slowly bring the ducky closer to [[rex]]. Rex tries to crawl away.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Come on, beta. Dekho, kuch nahi hoga.
scenes.say: कम ऑन, बेटा। देखो, कुछ नहीं होगा।

scenes.image: [[rex]] whimpers loudly, trying to burrow deeper into the sofa cushions.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Mujhe bachaao! Woh mujhe pakad lega!
scenes.say: मुझे बचाओ! वो मुझे पकड़ लेगा!

scenes.image: [[priya]] puts the ducky down, looking exasperated. Rex peeks out cautiously.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Meri toh samajh mein nahi aa raha.
scenes.say: मेरी तो समझ में नहीं आ रहा।

scenes.image: [[priya]] shows [[rex]] other toys – a ball, a rope. Rex is happy and playful.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Baaki sab toys se toh khelta hai.
scenes.say: बाकी सब टॉयज से तो खेलता है।

scenes.image: [[priya]] places the rubber ducky on the floor. [[rex]] instantly jumps onto the sofa, barking.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Away! Away! Don't touch me!
scenes.say: अवे! अवे! डोंट टच मी!

scenes.image: [[priya]] tries to lure [[rex]] with treats, but he refuses to come down while the ducky is there.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Dekho Rex, tumhara favorite treat.
scenes.say: देखो रेक्स, तुम्हारा फेवरेट ट्रीट।

scenes.image: [[rex]] staring intently at the ducky, drooling a little, but too scared to move.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Treat important hai, par life zyada!
scenes.say: ट्रीट इम्पोर्टेन्ट है, पर लाइफ ज्यादा!

scenes.image: [[priya]] sighs, picks up the ducky. [[rex]] immediately jumps down and takes the treat.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Okay, okay, main samajh gayi ab.
scenes.say: ओके, ओके, मैं समझ गई अब।

scenes.image: [[priya]] is on her laptop, searching 'dog afraid of small objects'. [[rex]] is sleeping peacefully.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maine online research karna shuru kiya.
scenes.say: मैंने ऑनलाइन रिसर्च करना शुरू किया।

scenes.image: [[priya]] tries to cover the ducky with a blanket. [[rex]] watches, suspicious.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Shayad agar woh dikhega nahi...
scenes.say: शायद अगर वो दिखेगा नहीं...

scenes.image: [[rex]] nudges the blanket with his nose, sees the ducky, then quickly backs away, barking.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Ab chhupkar attack karega kya?
scenes.say: अब छुपकर अटैक करेगा क्या?

scenes.image: [[priya]] is frustrated, holding her head in her hands. [[rex]] is far away, watching her.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Mera sherni dog, ek duck se darta hai!
scenes.say: मेरा शेरनी डॉग, एक डक से डरता है!

scenes.image: [[rex]] looks indignant, paws crossed.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Sherni nahi, shareef hoon main!
scenes.say: शेरनी नहीं, शरीफ हूँ मैं!

scenes.image: [[priya]] tries to show [[rex]] pictures of real ducks on her phone.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Dekho, yeh toh real duck hai.
scenes.say: देखो, ये तो रियल डक है।

scenes.image: [[rex]] looks at the phone, then at the rubber ducky, then back at the phone, looking confused.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Different hai, par phir bhi... scary!
scenes.say: डिफ़रेंट है, पर फिर भी... स्केरी!

scenes.image: [[priya]] attempts 'desensitization' training. Ducky is on one side of the room.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Slowly, slowly, we will conquer this.
scenes.say: स्लोली, स्लोली, वी विल कॉन्कर दिस।

scenes.image: [[rex]] is at the opposite end of the room, panting nervously, eyes glued to the ducky.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Conquer karna hai? Ya heart attack?
scenes.say: कॉन्कर करना है? या हार्ट अटैक?

scenes.image: [[priya]] moves the ducky a tiny bit closer. [[rex]] retreats immediately, bumping into a wall.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Oh God, this is harder than I thought.
scenes.say: ओह गॉड, दिस इस हार्डर दैन आई थॉट।

scenes.image: [[priya]] holds the ducky in her hand, looking determined. [[rex]] is watching from afar.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: I need to understand this fear.
scenes.say: आई नीड तो अंडरस्टेंड दिस फियर।

scenes.image: [[priya]] is cleaning the ducky with a cloth, deep in thought.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Priya ko laga shayad usmein kuch problem hai.
scenes.say: प्रिया को लगा शायद उसमें कुछ प्रॉब्लम है।

scenes.image: [[priya]] accidentally squeezes the ducky while cleaning it. A loud, piercing 'SQUEAK!' sound emoji appears.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: (Jumps) Oh! Itni tez awaaz!
scenes.say: (जंप्स) ओह! इतनी तेज़ आवाज़!

scenes.image: Close up on [[rex]], who was casually walking by. His ears flatten, eyes close tightly, he yelps in pain.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: AAAAAH! Yeh kya ho gaya hai!
scenes.say: आआआआह! ये क्या हो गया है!

scenes.image: [[rex]] collapses to the floor, covering his ears with his paws, whimpering loudly.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rex toh turant zameen par gir gaya.
scenes.say: रेक्स तो तुरंत ज़मीन पर गिर गया।

scenes.image: [[priya]] looks from the ducky in her hand to [[rex]]'s terrified form, realization dawning on her face.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Wait a minute... yeh kya ho raha hai?
scenes.say: वेट अ मिनट... ये क्या हो रहा है?

scenes.image: [[priya]] squeezes the ducky again, deliberately. Another loud, piercing 'SQUEAK!'
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Suno, yeh kitni tez awaaz hai!
scenes.say: सुनो, ये कितनी तेज़ आवाज़ है!

scenes.image: [[rex]] jumps high in the air, then runs under the bed, trembling uncontrollably.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Noooo! Mere kaan! My poor ears!
scenes.say: नूऊऊ! मेरे कान! माय पुअर इयर्स!

scenes.image: [[priya]] looks at the ducky, then at [[rex]], then back at the ducky, an 'aha!' moment.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Toh yeh baat hai! Iski awaaz se darta hai!
scenes.say: तो ये बात है! इसकी आवाज़ से डरता है!

scenes.image: Close up on [[priya]]'s face, now understanding everything. She looks amused and a little guilty.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Uff! Maine toh socha tha...
scenes.say: उफ़! मैंने तो सोचा था...

scenes.image: [[rex]] peeking out from under the bed, still looking traumatized.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Ab pata chala na! Kitna scary hai!
scenes.say: अब पता चला ना! कितना स्केरी है!

scenes.image: [[priya]] laughs, then walks towards the trash can, holding the ducky.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Sorry, buddy. Tera dushman gaya.
scenes.say: सॉरी, बडी। तेरा दुश्मन गया।

scenes.image: [[priya]] drops the ducky into the trash can. A small 'plink' sound.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aur aise, ducky ka chapter close ho gaya.
scenes.say: और ऐसे, डकी का चैप्टर क्लोज हो गया।

scenes.image: [[rex]] watches the ducky disappear into the trash, a huge sigh of relief escapes him.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Finally! Ghar mein shaanti, peace!
scenes.say: फाइनली! घर में शांति, पीस!

scenes.image: [[rex]] jumps out from under the bed, wagging his tail furiously, instantly happy.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aur Rex, pal bhar mein wapas normal.
scenes.say: और रेक्स, पल भर में वापस नॉर्मल।

scenes.image: [[rex]] runs to [[priya]], licking her face happily. Priya laughs.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Mera hero, ab theek hai!
scenes.say: मेरा हीरो, अब ठीक है!

scenes.image: [[rex]] fetches his favorite ball, dropping it at [[priya]]'s feet, inviting her to play.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Chalo, ab khelte hain! Koi darr nahi!
scenes.say: चलो, अब खेलते हैं! कोई डर नहीं!

scenes.image: [[priya]] throws the ball, [[rex]] chases it with gusto, looking completely fearless.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Woh ducky ki awaaz thi, jo use pasand nahi thi.
scenes.say: वो डकी की आवाज़ थी, जो उसे पसंद नहीं थी।

scenes.image: [[rex]] proudly brings the ball back, wagging his tail.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Na ki woh chhota sa yellow khilona.
scenes.say: ना कि वो छोटा सा येलो खिलौना।

scenes.image: [[priya]] scratching [[rex]] behind his ears, he leans into her touch.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Tum bade sensitive ho, mere pyaare Rex.
scenes.say: तुम बड़े सेंसिटिव हो, मेरे प्यारे रेक्स।

scenes.image: [[rex]] gives a goofy, happy grin, tongue lolling out.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Haan, bas thoda high-frequency hater!
scenes.say: हाँ, बस थोड़ा हाई-फ्रीक्वेंसी हेटर!

scenes.image: [[priya]] giving Rex a big, loving hug.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Ab samjha main, teri bravery ka raaz.
scenes.say: अब समझा मैं, तेरी ब्रेवरी का राज़।

scenes.image: [[rex]] looking confident and proud again.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Main toh lion hoon, bas loud noises... ugh!
scenes.say: मैं तो लायन हूँ, बस लाउड नोइसेज़... उफ़!

scenes.image: [[priya]] is smiling, looking at the empty spot where the ducky used to be.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Ajeeb hai na? Itne bade dog ko.
scenes.say: अजीब है ना? इतने बड़े डॉग को।

scenes.image: [[rex]] is happily chewing his ball, completely oblivious to his past terror.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Itni chhoti si awaaz se darr.
scenes.say: इतनी छोटी सी आवाज़ से डर।

scenes.image: [[priya]] shakes her head, still amused.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Animals ke bhi strange fears hote hain.
scenes.say: एनिमल्स के भी स्ट्रेंज फियर्स होते हैं।

scenes.image: Close up on [[rex]]'s face, now looking innocent and cute.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: Har hero ka ek weakness hota hai!
scenes.say: हर हीरो का एक वीकनेस होता है!

scenes.image: [[priya]] patting Rex, who is looking up at her lovingly.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Aur mera Rex, super hero hai.
scenes.say: और मेरा रेक्स, सुपर हीरो है।

scenes.image: [[rex]] wags his tail hard, showing his happiness.
scenes.speaker: rex
scenes.line: (Happy bark) Woof! My Priya, my protector!
scenes.say: (हैप्पी बार्क) वूफ़! माय प्रिया, माय प्रोटेक्टर!

scenes.image: [[priya]] is sitting on the floor, surrounded by Rex's normal toys.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Good thing we found out the real problem.
scenes.say: गुड थिंग वी फाउंड आउट द रियल प्रॉब्लम।

scenes.image: [[rex]] is peacefully sleeping at her feet, looking content.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Rex ab us ducky ke bina chain se so sakta tha.
scenes.say: रेक्स अब उस डकी के बिना चैन से सो सकता था।

scenes.image: [[priya]] smiling, looking at Rex.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Sometimes, sabse bade heroes ke bhi.
scenes.say: समटाइम्स, सबसे बड़े हीरोज़ के भी।

scenes.image: [[rex]] dreaming, paws twitching a little, a small smile on his face.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Chhote, funny fears hote hain.
scenes.say: छोटे, फनी फियर्स होते हैं।

scenes.image: [[priya]] winks at the camera, a mischievous smile.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Kiska dog, kis cheez se darta hai?
scenes.say: किसका डॉग, किस चीज़ से डरता है?

scenes.image: Final shot: [[rex]] looking at the camera, a slightly puzzled, innocent expression.
scenes.speaker: priya
scenes.line: Aapke pets ke aise funny fears hain kya?
scenes.say: आपके पेट्स के ऐसे फनी फियर्स हैं क्या?

caption: My Big Dog's Hilarious Fear of a Tiny Rubber Ducky 😂
yt_title: My Big Dog's Hilarious Fear of a Tiny Rubber Ducky 😂
description:
My brave German Shepherd, Rex, is afraid of the weirdest, smallest thing!
I tried everything to help him, but his terror just grew stronger.
What strange fears do your pets have?
comment_question: Aapke pets ke aise funny fears hain kya?
